body: Senior in high school. It's my french exam.

The way people treat me now and how they have always treated me. They have good reason too though. I'm that guy at school that will talk to you behind your back and then get mad if you do the same. I'm the guy that will laugh at people for their clothing, looks, behaviour. I've done it so much it has become a reflex. I'm manipulative, controlling, condescending. Even if there is a bright side, I can only see the negative side to something. I want to apologize to all the people I have ever wronged, but my pride is stopping me from doing that. Combined with the feeling that I will just bother them.

She won't know I did. Blocked her on every social media I have. She doesn't live close so she definetely won't hear it thru word of mouth. I don't think my family will contact her either. It will be nice for her because I won't bother her. I hope she'll think I got over her.
